items.keyData: MHF 60–62 Gy/20 fx or 70 Gy/28 fx · UHF 36.25–40 Gy/5 fx
items.summary: ASTRO's updated guideline in Practical Radiation Oncology (replacing the 2018 version) recommends moderate hypofractionation over conventional fractionation across risk groups and ultrahypofractionation (36.25–40 Gy/5 fx) for low- and intermediate-risk disease, conditionally for high/very-high risk; fewer than five fractions and UHF to elective pelvic nodes are limited to trials. MHF is conditionally preferred for patients with significant baseline urinary symptoms; focal MRI-guided boost may be considered.
items.title: ASTRO updates guideline: moderate hypofractionation for all risk groups, 5-fraction SBRT standard option for low/intermediate risk prostate cancer

items.summary: The analysis noted KEYNOTE-B49's sub-1-month PFS gain with numerically longer survival in the control arm and no OS benefit even in the high-PD-L1 subgroup, and flagged an eight-patient cohort for NECVAX-NEO1. NATALEE PI Dennis Slamon (UCLA) called continued curve separation after therapy ended very encouraging, and Man Li (Dalian Medical University) described sac-TMT survival benefit in heavily pretreated TNBC.
items.title: Clinical Trials Arena on ESMO breast data: KEYNOTE-B49's control arm lived longer; NATALEE's widening OS gap welcomed

items.keyData: DESTINY-Breast05 · IDFS HR 0.47 vs T-DM1 · 3-yr IDFS 92.4% vs 83.7%
items.summary: The European Commission approved single-agent T-DXd for adults with HER2-positive early breast cancer who have residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant taxane plus HER2-directed therapy, based on DESTINY-Breast05 versus T-DM1. It is T-DXd's first EU approval in a curative-intent setting.
items.title: EC approves trastuzumab deruxtecan as post-neoadjuvant therapy for HER2+ early breast cancer with residual disease

items.keyData: CERVINO · ORR 74.0% vs 45.7% · PFS risk reduction 60%
items.summary: AbbVie filed a biologics license application with the FDA for intravenous etentamig in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, supported by the phase 3 CERVINO trial against standard available therapies, which met its response and PFS endpoints.
items.title: AbbVie submits BLA for BCMA×CD3 bispecific etentamig in relapsed/refractory myeloma

items.keyData: HORIZON-Breast06 (LBA13) · mPFS 16.4 vs 6.8 mo · HR 0.27 · APEX-Breast01 (LBA27) · mPFS 16.4 vs 5.5 mo · HR 0.29
items.summary: In HORIZON-Breast06, trastuzumab rezetecan (SHR-A1811) improved PFS over physician's-choice chemotherapy in HER2-low advanced breast cancer; in APEX-Breast01 the biparatopic HER2 ADC TQB2102 did the same in HR+/HER2-low disease. OS is immature in both; ILD rates were 2.5% and 2.2%.
items.title: Two Chinese HER2 ADCs — trastuzumab rezetecan and TQB2102 — roughly triple PFS over chemotherapy in HER2-low MBC

items.keyData: LBA51 · mPFS 6.7 vs 6.0 mo · HR 0.74 · OS 21.0 vs 22.2 mo · HR 1.04
items.summary: Adding pembrolizumab to chemotherapy met the PFS primary endpoint in CPS ≥1 HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer, but the absolute gain was under a month and final OS showed no difference.
items.title: KEYNOTE-B49: pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy gives small PFS gain but no OS benefit in PD-L1+ HR+/HER2− MBC

items.keyData: LBA50 · mPFS 8.18 vs 4.01 mo · HR 0.41 · ORR 40.5% vs 20.2%
items.summary: Izalontamab brengitecan improved BICR-assessed PFS and response rate over single-agent chemotherapy in 383 previously treated patients with HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer; OS is immature and ILD occurred in 1.1%.
items.title: PANKU-Breast01: EGFR×HER3 bispecific ADC iza-bren doubles PFS over chemotherapy in pretreated HR+/HER2− MBC

items.keyData: LBA46 · 1-yr DFS 88.2% vs 65% historical (cis-eligible, n=17) · 61% vs 55% (cis-unfit, n=17)
items.summary: In the Spanish TTCC phase 2 RADIAN study, adding dostarlimab and niraparib to 70 Gy chemoradiotherapy improved 1-year DFS over historical controls in cisplatin-eligible patients, but not in cisplatin-unfit patients receiving RT alone, where all had grade ≥3 toxicity; several treatment-related deaths occurred across cohorts.
items.title: RADIAN: niraparib plus dostarlimab with (chemo)radiotherapy meets 1-year DFS goal in cisplatin-eligible locally advanced HNSCC

items.keyData: 12-mo LRR 20.2% vs 52.0% · mPFS 11.9 vs 6.3 mo · mOS 22.0 vs 14.0 mo
items.summary: In this randomised 2:1 trial (n=74 analysed), 40 Gy/5 fx SBRT after chemotherapy (mFOLFIRINOX or gem–nab-paclitaxel) more than halved 12-month locoregional recurrence versus chemotherapy alone, with longer PFS and OS; the inoperable subgroup did not reach significance.
items.title: AGITG MASTERPLAN: adding SBRT to chemotherapy cuts locoregional recurrence and lengthens survival in high-risk/locally advanced pancreatic cancer

items.keyData: mPFS 15.0 vs 5.7 mo · 51% risk reduction · mDoR 13.6 vs 6.8 mo
items.summary: In 455 Chinese patients, adding the TROP2 ADC sacituzumab tirumotecan to pembrolizumab improved PFS over the chemo-immunotherapy comparator (simultaneously published in NEJM); OS shows an early favourable trend. ESMO discussant Giannis Mountzios (Athens) called the PFS data potentially practice-changing for PD-L1-negative patients pending OS.
items.title: OptiTROP-Lung06: sac-TMT plus pembrolizumab nearly triples PFS in first-line PD-L1-negative nonsquamous NSCLC

items.keyData: LBA32 · vs chemo HR 0.37 · 5-yr OS 77% vs 46% · vs nivo HR 0.66 (p=0.043; threshold 0.0058)
items.summary: Final OS showed a large benefit for nivolumab plus ipilimumab over chemotherapy; versus nivolumab alone the OS difference did not meet the prespecified significance threshold, so superiority over nivolumab monotherapy for OS is not established.
items.title: CheckMate 8HW final OS: first-line nivolumab plus ipilimumab gives 77% 5-year survival in MSI-H/dMMR mCRC

items.summary: Erika Hamilton (Director of a Breast Cancer Research Program) highlighted large PFS gains for trastuzumab rezetecan and TQB2102 but noted APEX-Breast01 OS is only a trend; called NATALEE's OS benefit modest and nominal; found TALENT pCR 'still disappointing'; flagged the small eligible population and modest gain in KEYNOTE-B49, 93% diarrhoea with ipatasertib in FINER, and echoed Sandra Franco's critique that 'QOL maintained' can hide meaningful toxicity.
items.title: Erika Hamilton's breast take on ESMO 2026: HER2-low ADCs impress, NATALEE OS modest, KEYNOTE-B49 and TALENT disappoint

items.keyData: n=31 evaluable · PSA50 77% · PSA90 48% · ORR 69% (measurable disease)
items.summary: In a phase 1/2 study, the 50 mg dose of JNJ-6143 (formerly HLD-0915) produced deep PSA declines and confirmed objective responses in patients with a median of six prior therapies, with grade ≥3 TRAEs in 10%. A ~100-patient single-arm phase 2 is open.
items.title: Oral AR/BRD4 RIPTAC JNJ-6143 shows high PSA response rates in heavily pretreated mCRPC

items.summary: In the investigator-led TALENT trial, eight cycles of neoadjuvant T-DXd alone, with anastrozole, or followed by adjuvant chemotherapy produced objective responses in most patients but pCR rates in single digits; ESMO described these as sobering. T-DXd lowered tumour HER2 expression while TROP2 stayed high.
items.title: TALENT: neoadjuvant T-DXd yields high response but low pCR in HR+/HER2-low early breast cancer

items.summary: At 6 years, adding ribociclib to a nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor reduced the risk of death versus NSAI alone in stage II/III HR+/HER2− early breast cancer, with absolute iDFS and OS gains that have widened since 5 years. The OS p-value is nominal and the absolute OS gain modest.
items.title: NATALEE 6-year analysis: adjuvant ribociclib shows overall survival benefit in HR+/HER2− early breast cancer

items.keyData: LBA9 · mPFS 5.5 vs 1.4 mo · HR 0.33 (0.20–0.55) · OS HR 0.51 (NS, immature)
items.summary: In a Chinese open-label phase 3 (n=122, 2:1, crossover allowed), ris-rez markedly prolonged BICR-assessed PFS in relapsed/refractory osteosarcoma; OS remains immature and not significant.
items.title: ARTEMIS-011: B7-H3 ADC risvutatug rezetecan triples PFS vs gemcitabine–docetaxel in relapsed osteosarcoma

items.keyData: n=541 · PFS sig. but modest (no figures) · OS immature
items.summary: BioNTech and DualityBio reported a statistically significant but modest PFS gain over chemotherapy of choice in 541 patients after endocrine therapy, with ILD more frequent than in prior studies and immature OS; the companies said patient benefit would likely be limited and are weighing next steps.
items.title: DYNASTY-Breast02: trastuzumab pamirtecan meets PFS endpoint in HR+/HER2-low MBC, but sponsors call benefit limited

items.keyData: Phase 1/2: ORR 45% · CR/CRh 23% (n=22)
items.summary: Sumitomo Pharma's enzomenib (DSP-5336) received BTD based on preliminary clinical evidence; it is being tested in the phase 2 Horizen-1 study in KMT2A-rearranged and NPM1-mutated acute leukaemia.
items.title: FDA grants breakthrough therapy designation to menin inhibitor enzomenib in R/R KMT2A-rearranged acute leukaemia

items.keyData: TALAPRO-3 · n=599 · mrPFS NR vs 45.8 mo · HR 0.48 (0.36–0.65) · OS immature
items.summary: FDA approved the PARP inhibitor combination for adults with metastatic prostate cancer that is naïve or sensitive to androgen pathway modulation and carries HRR gene mutations (FDA-authorized test), based on TALAPRO-3; overall survival was immature at the rPFS analysis. Granted under priority review.
items.title: FDA approves talazoparib + enzalutamide for HRR-mutated metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer

items.summary: Hornstein (Northwell Health) said UNION's EFS signal is considerable but it changed two variables at once, used a non-current control and a low pCR bar, and did not study organ preservation; he said IROCAS means no adjuvant irinotecan, called AZUR-1 a likely new standard, and wanted a Western cohort and mature OS for G-HOPE-001. He also questioned SANO's 41.4 Gy dose and said an Indian mirtazapine-vs-olanzapine antiemetic trial (n=120) would change his practice.
items.title: Nicholas Hornstein's GI take on ESMO 2026: UNION design flaws, irinotecan out of adjuvant colon, AZUR-1 as new standard

items.keyData: LBA12 · mPFS 38.2 vs 8.4 mo · HR 0.57 · OS HR 0.77 (NS) · ORR 64.1% vs 62.1% · G≥3 TRAE 18.1% vs 50.7%
items.summary: Presented in Presidential Symposium III and published in The Lancet, chemo-free pembrolizumab more than quadrupled median PFS vs chemotherapy with far less grade ≥3 toxicity; OS favoured pembrolizumab but was not significant. The trial did not compare against current chemo-immunotherapy, and investigators said it does not show equivalence to that standard.
items.title: KEYNOTE-C93: first-line pembrolizumab alone beats carboplatin–paclitaxel in dMMR endometrial cancer

items.keyData: LBA10 · mPFS 25.0 vs 21.9 mo · HR 1.35 · OS HR ~2.0 favouring standard dosing
items.summary: The academic Unicancer trial randomised patients responding after 6 months of ICI to standard dosing or dosing every 12 weeks; PFS non-inferiority was not shown and OS was worse with reduced frequency (secondary endpoint). Investigators said the results cannot support adopting the extended-interval schedule.
items.title: MOIO: 3-monthly checkpoint-inhibitor dosing in responders fails non-inferiority, with an OS signal of harm

items.keyData: LBA11 · mPFS 7.2 vs 3.9 mo · HR 0.59 · mOS 19.0 vs 12.1 mo · HR 0.68
items.summary: In 776 patients progressing after platinum chemotherapy and a PD-(L)1 inhibitor, the TROP2 ADC improved both PFS and overall survival versus doxorubicin or paclitaxel at an interim OS analysis. Presenter Domenica Lorusso argued it should be considered a new standard in this setting.
items.title: TroFuse-005: sacituzumab tirumotecan improves OS and PFS over chemotherapy in endometrial cancer after platinum and IO

items.summary: In 231 Chinese patients with locally advanced rectal cancer, 25 Gy/5 fractions followed by CAPOX plus the PD-1 inhibitor camrelizumab improved event-free survival over 50.4 Gy chemoradiotherapy with CAPOX, with similar grade ≥3 toxicity.
items.title: UNION: short-course RT + CAPOX + camrelizumab improves 3-year EFS vs long-course chemoradiotherapy in LARC

items.keyData: n=70 · mPFS 13.9 vs 8.9 mo · no OS benefit
items.summary: In the CRUK-funded, UCL-sponsored randomised trial (70 patients, 19 UK hospitals), adding local consolidative radiotherapy to standard systemic therapy lengthened progression-free survival, though no overall survival benefit was shown.
items.title: SARON: consolidative radiotherapy extends PFS in synchronous oligometastatic NSCLC

items.keyData: LBA9 ARTEMIS-011 · LBA10 MIOIO · LBA11 TroFuse-005 · LBA12 KEYNOTE-C93
items.summary: The final Presidential session (26 Oct, 16:30–18:15 CET) features B7-H3 ADC risvutatug rezetecan vs gemcitabine–docetaxel in relapsed osteosarcoma, reduced-frequency checkpoint-inhibitor dosing (MIOIO), sacituzumab tirumotecan in pretreated endometrial cancer, and first-line pembrolizumab vs carboplatin–paclitaxel in dMMR endometrial cancer.
items.title: ESMO Presidential Symposium III today: ARTEMIS-011, MIOIO, TroFuse-005 and KEYNOTE-C93

items.keyData: lidERA 3-yr iDFS 92.4% vs 89.6% · never joint pain 23.4% vs 17.4% at cycle 6
items.summary: Breast oncologist Eleonora Teplinsky highlighted less frequent joint pain with adjuvant giredestrant (lidERA) but cautioned that trial-reported hot-flash/fatigue rates may not match clinic experience, and flagged short follow-up, no CDK4/6 combination data and unknown cost. She called TALENT's ~16–17% pCR/near-pCR with neoadjuvant T-DXd disappointing and POP-DURVA insufficient to change stage I TNBC care.
items.title: Early breast cancer at ESMO 2026: Eleonora Teplinsky on lidERA quality of life, TALENT and POP-DURVA

items.keyData: LBA7 · 3L+ mOS 10.0 vs 5.0 mo · HR 0.47 · ITT mOS 10.6 vs 6.4 mo · HR 0.58 · ITT PFS HR 0.77 (p=.053, NS)
items.summary: In CLDN18.2-positive (≥25%) advanced gastroesophageal carcinoma, sonesitatug vedotin 2.2 mg/kg improved OS versus investigator's-choice therapy in both the third-line-or-later and ITT populations; the ITT PFS co-primary endpoint was not statistically significant.
items.title: CLARITY-Gastric01: CLDN18.2 ADC sonesitatug vedotin extends OS in pretreated gastroesophageal cancer

items.keyData: LBA8 · mOS 14.9 vs 12.1 mo · HR 0.75 · mPFS 8.4 vs 5.8 mo · HR 0.61 · ORR 53.8% vs 32.5% · iCCA HR 0.63
items.summary: The PD-1/VEGF bispecific beat the current standard in a double-blind Chinese phase 3 (n=682) at interim OS analysis. Benefit was driven by intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (extrahepatic and gallbladder CIs crossed 1), and VEGF-type toxicities (proteinuria, hypertension) and grade 3/4 neutropenia were more frequent.
items.title: HARMONi-GI1: ivonescimab plus gem–cis improves OS over durvalumab plus gem–cis in first-line biliary tract cancer (China)

items.keyData: LBA5 · mPFS 9.8 vs 5.7 mo · HR 0.58 · mOS 17.7 vs 12.0 mo · HR 0.56 · ORR 58% vs 32% · G≥3 TRAE 24.6% vs 34.5%
items.summary: In the open-label phase 3 head-to-head trial (n=338), next-generation KRAS G12C inhibitor divarasib beat first-generation inhibitors (mostly sotorasib) on BICR-assessed PFS, with an OS benefit at the first interim analysis and fewer grade ≥3 TRAEs, though more low-grade GI toxicity. Caveats: open-label, no crossover, interim OS at 14.3 months' median follow-up.
items.title: Krascendo 1 full data: divarasib improves PFS and OS over sotorasib/adagrasib in pretreated KRAS G12C NSCLC

items.keyData: 3586O · treatment withdrawal 51.6% (belzutifan) / 51.4% (MK-1308A) vs 36.2% (control) over 108 wk
items.summary: The three-arm phase 3 (n=1,688) did not meet its objectives; neither triplet improved efficacy over pembrolizumab–lenvatinib, and treatment withdrawal was higher with both add-ons.
items.title: LITESPARK-012 at ESMO: adding belzutifan or quavonlimab to pembrolizumab–lenvatinib fails in first-line RCC

items.keyData: LBA6 · mPFS 7.6 vs 5.4 mo · HR 0.55 · mOS 17.8 vs 12.9 mo · HR 0.68 · ORR 51% vs 27%
items.summary: In 338 patients with MET overexpression and/or amplification confirmed on post-progression biopsy, the chemotherapy-free combination improved BICR PFS, with a significant OS gain at 53% maturity.
items.title: SAFFRON: osimertinib plus savolitinib beats platinum–pemetrexed after osimertinib progression in MET-driven EGFR-mutant NSCLC

items.keyData: n=475 · 2-yr OS 38.9% vs 29.4% (PCm vs DCF)
items.summary: In a Tata Memorial trial (n=475; Vanita Noronha and team) presented at ESMO, the outpatient PCm regimen gave higher 2-year OS than DCF, with more responses, more conversion to resectability and less toxicity, per Amol Akhade (Fortis Mumbai), who called it a potentially practice-changing, cost-effective option. HR and abstract details were not given in the report.
items.title: Tata Memorial phase 3: weekly paclitaxel–carboplatin plus metronomic therapy vs DCF in technically unresectable oral cancer

items.keyData: SARON OS HR 0.99 · GY020 G3/4 tox 43% vs 15% · TOP-1 5-yr local recurrence 14.8% (BCS alone)
items.summary: Jeff Ryckman (WVU Medicine) noted SANO's non-significant OS does not prove non-inferiority and its 41.4 Gy pre-op dose is arguably non-definitive; wanted RT QA and toxicity data for KEYNOTE-975; flagged confounded comparisons in MASTERPLAN pancreatic SBRT and no OS gain in SARON; and said GY020 (pembrolizumab + RT) missed its endpoint with more toxicity, leaving RT alone his default. He also urged caution on omitting both RT and endocrine therapy after TOP-1.
items.title: Radiation oncologist's take on ESMO 2026: Jeff Ryckman questions RT dose, QA and attribution across SANO, KEYNOTE-975, MASTERPLAN, SARON

items.summary: Amol Akhade (Fortis Hospitals Mumbai) questioned whether INTerpath-001's recurrence benefit will translate into OS and cautioned against cross-trial comparison with neoadjuvant pembrolizumab; noted the VOLGA tremelimumab triplet added toxicity without OS gain; called SANO's higher distant-metastasis rate concerning for surveillance; and described TALENT pCR results as disappointing. He saw VOLGA and DeLLphi-305 as potentially standard-setting.
items.title: Indian view on ESMO 2026: Amol Akhade weighs INTerpath-001, VOLGA, SANO and TALENT

items.keyData: COMPANION-002 · ORR 18.0% vs 5.3% · mPFS 4.7 vs 2.6 mo · HR 0.44 · adjusted OS HR 0.85 (0.59–1.26)
items.summary: Full results of the randomised phase 2/3 trial of DLL4×VEGF-A bispecific tovecimig plus paclitaxel (n=168) were published in JCO and presented orally at ESMO by Nilofer Azad. The ITT OS difference was not significant; the sponsor attributes this to 54% control-arm crossover and reports a post hoc crossover-adjusted HR that also crosses 1.
items.title: COMPANION-002 published in JCO: tovecimig plus paclitaxel improves ORR and PFS but not OS in second-line biliary tract cancer

items.keyData: LBA4 · MFS-CI HR 0.42 · 4-yr MFS 95% vs 88% · PSA-PFS HR 0.47 · OS HR 0.88 (NS) · G≥3 AE 43% vs 36%
items.summary: In this ANZUP-led placebo-controlled phase 3 trial (n=1,106; 85% definitive RT, 15% salvage; pelvic nodal RT in over 90%), 96 weeks of darolutamide with ADT and RT reduced metastasis on conventional imaging at a planned interim analysis. OS and cancer-specific survival are immature, the endpoint used conventional rather than PSMA imaging, and the analysis rested on 87 events.
items.title: DASL-HiCaP: darolutamide added to ADT and radiotherapy improves metastasis-free survival in very high-risk localised prostate cancer

items.summary: After first-line platinum–etoposide–durvalumab, adding the DLL3×CD3 T-cell engager tarlatamab to durvalumab maintenance improved overall and progression-free survival versus durvalumab alone in this open-label phase 3 trial (n=563), published simultaneously in NEJM. OS is from a prespecified interim analysis and still immature; CRS occurred in about half of patients, almost all grade 1–2.
items.title: DeLLphi-305: tarlatamab plus durvalumab maintenance extends OS in ES-SCLC (Presidential, NEJM)

items.keyData: IMA402 (1955RO) · cORR 25% overall, 32% PRAME-high · IMA203CD8 (1946O) · cORR 41% (n=87) · gyn ≥DL4c cORR 55%
items.summary: Early-phase data presented in two ESMO orals: the PRAME×CD3 bispecific IMA402 produced confirmed responses mainly in PRAME-high melanoma, and the CD8-enhanced TCR-T cell therapy IMA203CD8 showed responses across melanoma, gynaecologic cancers and synovial sarcoma. Data are preliminary sponsor-reported results.
items.title: PRAME-targeted bispecific IMA402 and TCR-T IMA203CD8 show activity in melanoma and gynaecologic cancers

items.keyData: KEYNOTE-975 · CPS≥10 · mEFS 15.2 vs 14.7 mo · HR 0.97 · mOS 32.2 vs 35.0 mo · HR 1.00 · fatal AE 13% vs 10%
items.summary: In 703 patients receiving definitive chemoradiotherapy, concurrent and maintenance pembrolizumab gave no event-free or overall survival gain over placebo in the PD-L1 CPS≥10 population at the second interim analysis, with more fatal AEs and discontinuations; the study has been stopped. Presented by Manish Shah in an ESMO upper-GI proffered paper session.
items.title: KEYNOTE-975: pembrolizumab added to definitive chemoradiotherapy fails to improve EFS or OS in oesophageal cancer

items.keyData: LBA78 · 5-yr OS 50% vs 54% · HR 1.17 (0.77–1.77) · distant mets 46% vs 29% (P<0.01) · 43% surgery avoided
items.summary: Long-term results (median follow-up 76 months, 309 patients) of the Dutch stepped-wedge trial showed no significant OS difference between active surveillance and standard oesophagectomy in clinical complete responders, with 43% of surveillance patients avoiding surgery, but a significantly higher cumulative incidence of distant metastases with surveillance.
items.title: SANO 5-year: active surveillance after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy gives similar OS to surgery but more distant metastases

items.keyData: LBA2 · EFS HR 0.51 · 24-mo EFS 64% vs 45% · OS HR 0.58 · 24-mo OS 78% vs 69% · pCR 45% vs 10% · G3–4 AE 64% vs 44%
items.summary: Presented in the Presidential Symposium and published in NEJM, the durvalumab–EV doublet cut the risk of events and death compared with cystectomy alone in patients ineligible for or declining cisplatin. The tremelimumab triplet arm improved EFS but not OS and was more toxic. An FDA priority review is under way.
items.title: VOLGA: perioperative durvalumab plus neoadjuvant enfortumab vedotin improves EFS and OS in cisplatin-ineligible MIBC

items.keyData: MajesTEC-9 · PFS HR 0.29 · 18-mo PFS 69.8% vs 26.9% · OS HR 0.60 · 18-mo OS 79.2% vs 68.6%
items.summary: The European Commission approved teclistamab as monotherapy for adults with RRMM after at least one prior therapy, based on the phase 3 MajesTEC-9 trial versus PVd or Kd. The BCMA×CD3 bispecific improved both PFS and OS.
items.title: EC approves teclistamab monotherapy for relapsed/refractory myeloma from first relapse

items.keyData: G-HOPE-001 · mPFS 7.1 vs 3.1 mo · HR 0.45 · mOS 10.2 vs 6.9 mo · HR 0.57 · ORR 37.4% vs 7.7%
items.summary: In this phase 3 trial (China and Japan) of 464 patients with CLDN18.2-positive gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma after 2–4 prior regimens, arcotatug tavatecan (IBI343) monotherapy beat physician's-choice chemotherapy on both PFS and OS. Presented as an ESMO 2026 late-breaker; results so far come from the sponsor's release.
items.title: G-HOPE-001: CLDN18.2 ADC arcotatug tavatecan improves PFS and OS over chemotherapy in pretreated gastric/GEJ cancer

items.keyData: RFS HR 0.58 · 2-yr RFS 82.2% vs 70.0% · NNT ≈ 9 · severe AEs 14.2% vs 13.4% · commentators: H. Shaw (UCLH), A. Melcher (ICR), L. Lee (Oxford), C. Sweeney (Adelaide)
items.summary: UK and Australian oncologists and immunologists, commenting through the Science Media Centre, called the phase 3 result a strong proof of principle for personalised neoantigen therapy. They cautioned that overall survival is immature, the benefit was shown only in resected melanoma, low-grade side effects (fever, fatigue) were more common, and cost and manufacturing could limit access.
items.title: INTerpath-001: independent experts welcome mRNA vaccine result but want OS and longer follow-up

items.keyData: KEYNOTE-365 cohort I · mOS 10.2 vs 7.1 mo · HR 0.33 · ORR 28% vs 15%
items.summary: In a small randomised cohort (n=70) of metastatic neuroendocrine prostate cancer, adding pembrolizumab to platinum–etoposide improved response rate and overall survival, most clearly in PD-L1 CPS ≥1. Authors flagged small numbers and post hoc subgroups.
items.title: KEYNOTE-365 cohort I: pembrolizumab plus carboplatin–etoposide prolongs OS in neuroendocrine prostate cancer

items.summary: The placebo-controlled phase 3 trial in 907 cisplatin-eligible MIBC patients did not meet its EFS endpoint; pCR was numerically higher with pembrolizumab but OS was identical. Investigators concluded the data do not support this combination, leaving durvalumab-chemo and EV-pembrolizumab as the perioperative options.
items.title: KEYNOTE-866: adding perioperative pembrolizumab to neoadjuvant cisplatin–gemcitabine fails to improve EFS in MIBC

items.keyData: ctDNA clearance 82.1% vs 66.7% · 24-mo EFS baseline ctDNA+ 71.2% vs 54.2% (HR 0.54) · post-op ctDNA− HR 0.48
items.summary: In an exploratory ESMO 2026 analysis of cisplatin-eligible MIBC, more baseline ctDNA-positive patients cleared ctDNA before surgery with enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab, and EFS benefit was clearest in baseline ctDNA-positive and post-surgery ctDNA-negative groups. Persistently ctDNA-positive patients did poorly in both arms.
items.title: KEYNOTE-B15 ctDNA analysis: perioperative EV–pembrolizumab clears ctDNA more often than gemcitabine–cisplatin in MIBC

items.keyData: IOV-COM-202 cohort 1A (n=24) · ORR 62.5% · CR 29.2% · mPFS 19.8 mo · mDOR NR
items.summary: In a 24-patient phase 2 cohort with about 4 years of follow-up, adding lifileucel to pembrolizumab produced high and durable response rates, with median OS not reached. The randomised phase 3 TILVANCE-301 is enrolling.
items.title: Lifileucel TIL therapy plus pembrolizumab shows durable responses in frontline advanced melanoma (IOV-COM-202)

items.keyData: RASolute 302 · mOS 13.2 vs 6.7 mo · HR 0.40 · G12D HR 0.49 · G12V HR 0.32 · G12R HR 0.61 (CI crosses 1)
items.summary: Exploratory ESMO 2026 analyses showed the overall survival advantage of daraxonrasib over chemotherapy was consistent across G12D and G12V mutations, control regimens and prior-treatment settings. Estimates for G12R, Q61 and RAS-wild-type subgroups were imprecise, with confidence intervals crossing 1.
items.title: RASolute 302 subgroups: daraxonrasib OS benefit holds across RAS genotypes and chemotherapy comparators in pretreated PDAC

items.keyData: ORR 82% · 9-mo progression-free 88% (small phase 1/2 cohort)
items.summary: Updated phase 1/2 data at ESMO 2026 for Tango's MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor combined with daraxonrasib in previously treated MTAP-deleted, RAS-mutant PDAC reported responses in most patients and few progressions at 9 months. Numbers are from small early-phase cohorts; a first-line phase 3 is being planned.
items.title: Chemo-free PRMT5 inhibitor vopimetostat plus daraxonrasib shows high response rates in MTAP-deleted pancreatic cancer

items.keyData: Phase 3 RFS HR 0.58 vs phase 2 HR 0.51 · DMFS risk −38% · comment from BMO, RBC, William Blair
items.summary: After the abstract leaked ahead of ESMO, analysts said the RFS hazard ratio sat at the low end of expectations compared with the phase 2 result. They also asked whether adding the vaccine after surgery offers more than neoadjuvant pembrolizumab, which achieved similar results in earlier trials at lower cost. One firm noted the benefit looked consistent across disease subgroups.
items.title: INTerpath-001 seen as below expectations by analysts, who question value against neoadjuvant immunotherapy

items.keyData: INTerpath-001 · n=1137 · RFS HR 0.58 · 2-yr RFS 82.2% vs 70.0% · DMFS HR 0.62 · G3-5 TRAE 14.2% vs 13.4%
items.summary: Detailed phase 3 results, released early ahead of the ESMO Presidential Symposium (LBA1), show improved recurrence-free and distant metastasis-free survival when intismeran autogene is added to adjuvant pembrolizumab in resected stage IIB–IV melanoma; curves separate only after about 6 months and OS is immature.
items.title: INTerpath-001 full data: individualised mRNA vaccine intismeran plus pembrolizumab cuts recurrence in resected melanoma

items.keyData: KEYNOTE-158 · n=220 (TMB ≥13) · ORR 36% · DOR ≥12 mo in 58%
items.summary: Pembrolizumab (IV or subcutaneous Keytruda Qlex) now has traditional approval for previously treated unresectable/metastatic TMB-high solid tumours without satisfactory alternatives, with TMB-H redefined as ≥13 mut/Mb because benefit was not confirmed at 10 to <13 mut/Mb.
items.title: FDA converts pembrolizumab TMB-H approval to traditional approval, raising threshold to ≥13 mut/Mb

items.keyData: Phase 1a/b · DCR 84.6% (33/39) · 3 PRs
items.summary: After an end-of-phase 2 meeting, Rgenta will run a ~150-patient double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 in biomarker-selected recurrent/metastatic ACC (two doses vs placebo, 2:2:1, PFS primary), starting in Q1 2027.
items.title: FDA agrees phase 3 design for oral MYB splicing modulator RGT-61159 in adenoid cystic carcinoma

items.keyData: 4 RCTs · n=1397 · pooled OS HR 0.95 · PFS HR 0.89 · ADRIATIC OS HR 0.73
items.summary: A pooled analysis of four randomised trials (1,397 patients) found no significant overall OS or PFS gain from adding immune checkpoint inhibitors to chemoradiotherapy in limited-stage SCLC, with ADRIATIC consolidation durvalumab the only trial showing a significant OS benefit and no excess grade 3–4 toxicity overall.
items.title: Meta-analysis: adding checkpoint inhibitors to chemoradiotherapy in LS-SCLC — benefit confined to consolidation durvalumab

items.keyData: Phase 1 (NCT05549661) · n=9 · clinical benefit in 3 · stable disease in 3
items.summary: FDA granted orphan status to oral PLK1 inhibitor onvansertib for chronic myelomonocytic leukaemia, based on an early Mayo Clinic/NCI phase 1 dose-escalation study in relapsed/refractory proliferative CMML and MDS/MPN overlap with RAS-pathway mutations.
items.title: Orphan drug designation for PLK1 inhibitor onvansertib in CMML

items.summary: Samsung Bioepis' first ADC, SBE303, pairs an anti-Nectin-4 antibody with a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload via a beta-glucuronide cleavable linker; the designation covers locally advanced/metastatic urothelial cancer previously treated with enfortumab vedotin. A first-in-human phase 1 (NCT07524348) plans 149 patients.
items.title: Fast track for Nectin-4 ADC SBE303 in urothelial cancer after enfortumab vedotin

items.summary: First-in-human phase 1 data in 105 patients with high-grade ovarian cancer show responses both in tumours with lower and higher FRα expression; pneumonitis/ILD occurred in 11% and no grade ≥3 neuropathy or keratopathy was seen. The exatecan-based ADC already holds FDA breakthrough designation in platinum-resistant disease.
items.title: Annals of Oncology: FRα ADC sofetabart mipitecan active across FRα expression levels in ovarian cancer

items.summary: The European Commission approved neoadjuvant pembrolizumab plus enfortumab vedotin, continued as adjuvant therapy after radical cystectomy, for adults with resectable muscle-invasive bladder cancer irrespective of cisplatin eligibility; subcutaneous pembrolizumab is included. Support comes from KEYNOTE-B15/EV-304 versus neoadjuvant gemcitabine–cisplatin in cisplatin-eligible patients.
items.title: EC approves perioperative pembrolizumab plus enfortumab vedotin for resectable MIBC

items.keyData: JUPITER-06 · mOS 17.7 vs 12.9 mo · PFS risk reduced 42%
items.summary: Dr. Reddy's received DCGI approval for toripalimab (Zytorvi) plus paclitaxel–cisplatin as first-line treatment of unresectable, advanced, recurrent or metastatic oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma, its second Indian indication after nasopharyngeal carcinoma. The Indian label does not require PD-L1 selection.
items.title: India's DCGI approves toripalimab with chemotherapy for first-line advanced oesophageal SCC

items.summary: City of Hope researchers reported in Nature Communications that thoracic radiation shifts protective ILC2s towards inflammatory ILC1s via IFN-β in mice, with similar changes in human ILCs; blocking IFN-β signalling during radiation reduced pneumonitis and fibrosis in the model.
items.title: Type I interferon drives innate lymphoid cell switch behind radiation-induced lung injury (preclinical)

items.keyData: Combi-TED (n=106) · 1-yr OS 47% (+docetaxel) / 46% (+nivolumab) vs 29% docetaxel
items.summary: In the randomised phase 2 Combi-TED trial in HLA-A2-positive metastatic NSCLC progressing after first-line chemo-immunotherapy, both OSE2101 (Tedopi) combinations met the 1-year OS endpoint while docetaxel alone did not. Final results are slated for ESMO 2026.
items.title: Combi-TED: neoepitope vaccine OSE2101 with docetaxel or nivolumab improves 1-year OS in second-line NSCLC

items.keyData: Phase 1 + cetuximab · CRC (n=5) ORR 40%, DCR 60% · PDAC (n=7) cORR 29% · G≥3 TRAEs 24%
items.summary: The FDA granted fast track designation to QTX3034, an oral non-covalent multi-KRAS inhibitor that binds inactive KRAS with G12D preference, combined with cetuximab with or without FOLFOX for KRAS G12D-mutated CRC. Phase 1 combination data will be presented at ESMO 2026 on 24 October.
items.title: Fast track for KRAS G12D-preferring inhibitor QTX3034 plus cetuximab in colorectal cancer

items.keyData: TASKIN (n=159) · 12-mo OS 61.3% vs 55.7% · mPFS 5.9 vs 5.6 mo · right-sided OS HR 0.38 (exploratory)
items.summary: The investigator-sponsored randomised, placebo-controlled phase 2 TASKIN trial met its prespecified 12-month survival threshold with vilamakitug added to trifluridine/tipiracil, but PFS did not differ; an exploratory right-sided subgroup showed an OS signal.
items.title: TASKIN: IL-1α antibody vilamakitug plus trifluridine/tipiracil meets 12-month OS threshold in refractory mCRC

items.keyData: Preclinical · ~5× tumour inhibition vs monomeric ADC in SU.86.86 xenograft · DAR ~5
items.summary: FDA granted fast track designation to Medicovestor's MC001, a tetravalent anti-folate receptor alpha antibody dimer carrying MMAE, for advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer. IND has been cleared but the phase 1 trial (also open to other FRα-expressing solid tumours) has not started; supporting data are preclinical only.
items.title: Fast track for dimeric FRα-targeted ADC MC001 in advanced pancreatic cancer

items.keyData: CK-301-101 LA cohort · n=31 · ORR 54.8% · CR 25.8% · 24-mo DOR rate 80.2%
items.summary: NCCN guidelines now include the PD-L1 antibody cosibelimab-ipdl (Unloxcyt, Sun Pharma) as a category 2A preferred therapy for locally advanced CSCC not suitable for curative surgery or radiation, extending its existing preferred status in metastatic disease.
items.title: NCCN lists cosibelimab as category 2A preferred option for locally advanced cutaneous SCC

items.keyData: EMBOLD PanTumour-101 · ORR 61% (8 mg/kg) vs 32% (6 mg/kg) · G≥3 TRAEs 42% vs 15% · ILD 2%
items.summary: GSK reported phase 1b dose-optimisation data from EMBOLD PanTumour-101 in 50 patients with relapsed ES-SCLC (median 2 prior lines), with higher responses at 8 mg/kg than 6 mg/kg but more grade ≥3 toxicity; follow-up is short and full data come at ESMO 2026.
items.title: B7-H3 ADC risvutatug rezetecan shows high response rates in relapsed extensive-stage SCLC

items.keyData: n=236 · 24-mo EFS 86% vs 67% (P<.001) · OS 90% vs 85% · relapse 5% vs 13% · G≥3 SAEs 34% vs 47%
items.summary: The phase 3 trial randomised 236 adults (2:1) to ponatinib–blinatumomab or imatinib plus chemotherapy; the chemo-free arm had higher 24-month EFS, fewer relapses and fewer early deaths and serious AEs. OS difference was smaller; full results are now published in NEJM.
items.title: GIMEMA ALL2820 in NEJM: chemotherapy-free ponatinib plus blinatumomab beats imatinib-chemo in newly diagnosed Ph+ ALL

items.keyData: CR 71% · median DOR 26.6 mo · CR at 36 mo 44.2% · 36-mo cystectomy-free 84.2% · DSS 98.2%
items.summary: Long-term results in 100 patients with BCG-unresponsive CIS ± papillary NMIBC, published in the Journal of Urology, show durable complete responses and low progression to muscle-invasive disease, with mostly grade 1–2 local toxicity.
items.title: QUILT-3.032 3-year data: nogapendekin alfa plus BCG keeps most responders cystectomy-free in BCG-unresponsive CIS NMIBC

items.keyData: REGAIN (NCT06910306) · enrolment 10→20 · single-arm, 3 US centres · SNO 2026 presentation 13 Nov
items.summary: An IDE supplement doubles enrolment in the US REGAIN feasibility study of diffusing alpha-emitter radiation therapy for unresectable recurrent glioblastoma after prior brain RT, adds IDH-mutant grade 4 tumours, and adds PFS and quality-of-life endpoints. New data are due at SNO in November.
items.title: FDA approves expansion of Alpha DaRT alpha-emitter brachytherapy trial in recurrent glioblastoma

items.keyData: LBA7 CLARITY-Gastric01 (CLDN18.2 ≥25%) · LBA6 SAFFRON osimertinib+savolitinib · LBA3 DeLLphi-305 tarlatamab+durvalumab · LBA2 VOLGA
items.summary: AstraZeneca will present overall survival from four phase 3 trials at ESMO (23–27 Oct). CLARITY-Gastric01 is described as the first phase 3 to show a significant OS benefit with a CLDN18.2 ADC (sonesitatug vedotin) in ≥2L gastric/GEJ cancer; numbers are embargoed until presentation.
items.title: ESMO 2026 Presidential Symposia: CLARITY-Gastric01, SAFFRON, DeLLphi-305 and VOLGA OS data to be presented

items.keyData: AZUR-1 · n=154 · up to 9 doses q3w × 6 mo · ~3/4 free of surgery/RT/chemo at >2 y median FU · MSK study n=50: 93% cancer-free ≥12 mo
items.summary: Single-agent dostarlimab is now approved for previously untreated stage II–III dMMR/MSI-H rectal cancer, offering a non-operative route that can spare chemotherapy, radiotherapy and surgery. Approval rests on interim AZUR-1 data; continued follow-up is required to confirm durable benefit.
items.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to dostarlimab for dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer

items.keyData: Krascendo 1 · divarasib vs sotorasib or adagrasib · ESMO LBA5, 25 Oct · no numbers released
items.summary: Roche reports that next-generation KRAS G12C inhibitor divarasib showed superiority over first-generation inhibitors in previously treated KRAS G12C-mutated NSCLC; full data will be presented as LBA5 on 25 October. Roche will also present TAISHAN-301 interim phase 3 data in nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
items.title: Krascendo 1: divarasib superior to sotorasib/adagrasib in pretreated KRAS G12C NSCLC, LBA at ESMO

items.keyData: Local phase 3 (efficacy, immunogenicity, PK) · phase 4 required
items.summary: Lupin received Indian approval for a nivolumab biosimilar, made with Virchow Biotech, covering the reference product's indications. Approval was supported by a local phase 3 comparative study, with a phase 4 real-world study mandated.
items.title: CDSCO clears Lupin's nivolumab biosimilar for manufacture and marketing in India

items.keyData: NeoORB · interim n=60 · breast pCR 51.9% vs 27.3% (P=.046) · nodal pCR 88.5% vs 39.4% · G≥3 surgical complications 14.8% vs 6.1%
items.summary: An Indian randomised phase 3 trial gave ultrahypofractionated radiotherapy (26 Gy/5 fractions plus boost) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy and before surgery, versus standard postoperative RT. Interim results show higher breast and nodal pCR, with more grade ≥3 surgical complications; numbers are small and final outcomes awaited.
items.title: NeoORB (AIIMS Jodhpur): neoadjuvant 5-fraction RT before surgery doubles breast pCR in interim analysis

items.keyData: UTOPIA · n=99 · 3-mo CR 77.8% · 6-mo event-free in CR pts 94.5%
items.summary: FDA accepted UroGen's NDA for UGN-103, a next-generation intravesical mitomycin hydrogel, as a non-surgical option for recurrent LG-IR-NMIBC. Filing is based on the single-arm phase 3 UTOPIA trial.
items.title: UGN-103 (sustained-release mitomycin gel) in recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk NMIBC

items.keyData: TARGIT-B · n=1,684 · 4-y LR 2.3% vs 2.1% · distant relapse HR 0.68 (P=.087) · young subgroup 7-y DR 4.3% vs 17.0%, HR 0.33
items.summary: In the phase 3 TARGIT-B trial, a tumour-bed boost delivered as intraoperative radiotherapy at lumpectomy gave local recurrence similar to a postoperative external-beam boost, both with whole-breast RT. Distant relapse was not significantly reduced overall but was markedly lower in the young-patient subgroup (ASTRO 2026, abstract 349).
items.title: TARGIT-B: intraoperative RT boost matches EBRT boost for local control, with fewer distant relapses in young women

items.keyData: FURTHER · ORR 68% (240 mg) vs 43% (160 mg) · mPFS 16.0 vs 11.1 mo · intracranial ORR 47%
items.summary: The phase 1b FURTHER trial, published in Cancer Cell, randomized treatment-naive patients with EGFR P-loop/αC-helix compressing (PACC) mutations to firmonertinib 160 or 240 mg daily; the higher dose gave higher response rates and longer PFS with CNS activity. The phase 3 ALPACCA trial will compare 240 mg with osimertinib or afatinib.
items.title: FURTHER: firmonertinib 240 mg shows activity in first-line EGFR PACC-mutant NSCLC, including brain metastases

items.keyData: IDEA · n=200 · RS ≤18 · freedom from recurrence 99% at 5 y, 94% at 8 y · median FU 7.9 y
items.summary: Eight-year follow-up of the single-arm phase 2 IDEA trial (endocrine therapy alone after breast-conserving surgery in women 50–69 with stage I ER+/HER2− tumours and recurrence score ≤18) shows high freedom from recurrence, with most ipsilateral events after year 5. Discussants stressed that omission depends on endocrine therapy adherence.
items.title: IDEA long-term: omitting RT after lumpectomy in low-risk luminal breast cancer keeps recurrence low, but late events rise

items.keyData: NEONIPIGA · n=32 · pCR 59% · 4-y OS 84.1% · 4-y EFS 83.5% · median FU 48 mo
items.summary: Long-term follow-up of the French phase 2 NEONIPIGA trial of perioperative nivolumab plus ipilimumab in resectable dMMR/MSI-H gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma reports high 4-year OS and EFS after a 59% pCR rate. Authors note no clear survival advantage over historical surgery outcomes and suggest randomized organ-preservation studies.
items.title: NEONIPIGA 4-year data: neoadjuvant nivolumab–ipilimumab gives durable survival in localized MSI-H gastric/GEJ cancer

items.keyData: n=385 (56 WW) · Wexner −4.8 · severe incontinence at 5 y 11% (WW cCR) vs 53% (matched TME)
items.summary: A post hoc analysis of the German CAO/ARO/AIO-12 and -16 TNT trials found clinically meaningful long-term benefits in faecal incontinence, stool frequency, role and global health scores for patients managed by watch-and-wait versus immediate TME. Severe incontinence at 5 years was far less common after sustained clinical complete response; the analysis is non-randomized.
items.title: Watch-and-wait after total neoadjuvant therapy preserves bowel function and QOL over 5 years in rectal cancer

items.keyData: n=23 · 40 Gy/5 fx or 36 Gy/3 fx · 1-y RFS 71.4% vs benchmark 55.7% (P=.09) · 1-y OS 95.2%
items.summary: A single-centre phase 2 trial gave stereotactic radiotherapy to the inferior vena cava thrombus 4–14 days before radical nephrectomy and thrombectomy; 1-year RFS exceeded the historical surgery-alone benchmark without grade 4–5 radiation toxicity or 90-day perioperative deaths. Published in JAMA Oncology; findings are exploratory.
items.title: Neoadjuvant SABR to IVC tumour thrombus before nephrectomy shows recurrence-free survival signal in RCC

items.summary: In a Chinese phase 3 trial of 369 women with stage II–III TNBC, adding the PD-1 antibody camrelizumab to six cycles of neoadjuvant docetaxel–carboplatin (then adjuvant camrelizumab) improved pathological complete response versus chemotherapy alone. Results are in press in Annals of Oncology; event-free survival data are not yet mature.
items.title: HELEN-Trio 011: camrelizumab with anthracycline-free docetaxel–carboplatin raises pCR in early TNBC

items.keyData: 137 drugs · margin ≤30% of MRP · effective 9 Nov 2026 · MRP cuts up to 70% · est. savings ₹2,500 cr/yr
items.summary: The NPPA notified a cap on trade margins for 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs (patented and generic, including nivolumab, olaparib and denosumab) at 30% of MRP, effective 9 November 2026. Quantities supplied through patient assistance programmes are excluded; manufacturers must report revised prices within seven days.
items.title: India finalises 30% trade-margin cap on 137 cancer drugs from 9 November

items.keyData: n=420 · household changes 56.2% at ~2 mo → 81.2% at 26 mo
items.summary: A study embedded in a Children's Oncology Group trial of 420 children with standard-risk B-ALL found that household changes (employment and/or marital status) were common soon after diagnosis and increased over treatment. Less frequent vincristine/dexamethasone pulses (every 12 vs 4 weeks) were linked to fewer families reporting leukaemia-related expenses, but most other family outcomes did not differ.
items.title: JNCCN: standard-risk childhood ALL disrupts most families' employment or household within two years

items.keyData: n=2,821,166 · non-metro vs large-metro death HR 1.034 (2010–16) → 1.093 (2017–23)
items.summary: Two analyses presented at the 2026 ASCO Quality Care Symposium — National Cancer Database data on 2.8 million women and registry/mortality data from 1995–2022 — show non-metro patients' survival disadvantage growing over time, with rural breast cancer mortality moving from below to above urban rates. Distant-stage incidence of several screen-detectable cancers rose faster in rural areas.
items.title: US rural–urban gaps in breast cancer survival and mortality are widening

items.keyData: n=2,129 HR+/HER2− · 5-yr recurrence-free 95.5% (low) vs 89.6% (high risk) · +22% relative risk per 10-point score rise
items.summary: SimBioSys's TumorSight Risk combines the diagnostic breast MRI with pathology and clinical data to give a 0–100 recurrence-risk score and low/intermediate/high category, and can be run before surgery. Validation used 2,129 women with early HR+/HER2− breast cancer.
items.title: FDA-cleared AI tool TumorSight Risk estimates recurrence risk from diagnostic breast MRI

items.keyData: RT CHARM (A221505) · complications 12.3% vs 10.2% (non-inferior) · 3-yr LRR 1.5% vs 2.2% · median FU 3.9 yr
items.summary: The phase 3 Alliance A221505 trial randomised 898 women undergoing mastectomy with planned reconstruction to chest-wall and nodal RT in 16 fractions versus 25 fractions. Reconstruction complications at 24 months were non-inferior with the shorter course, with no significant differences in locoregional recurrence or toxicity; full results are now published in JCO.
items.title: RT CHARM: 3-week hypofractionated post-mastectomy RT non-inferior to 5 weeks for reconstruction complications

items.keyData: 350 mg q3w × 12 wk → 700 mg q6w · PK/PD modelling-based
items.summary: The CHMP recommended an updated Libtayo schedule: 350 mg every 3 weeks for the first 12 weeks, then 700 mg every 6 weeks, across all six approved EU indications. The opinion rests on PK/PD modelling integrated with existing clinical data; a European Commission decision is pending.
items.title: CHMP backs every-6-weeks cemiplimab dosing across all EU indications

items.summary: At its 12–15 October meeting the CHMP gave positive opinions on indication extensions for Talvey (talquetamab) and Tukysa (tucatinib) and recommended Kizfizo, a hybrid temozolomide product for glioma. It declined to extend gemtuzumab ozogamicin to children with newly diagnosed AML, and the applications to extend palbociclib (HR+/HER2+ maintenance) and capivasertib (PTEN-deficient hormone-sensitive mPC) were withdrawn.
items.title: CHMP October: talquetamab and tucatinib extensions backed; paediatric Mylotarg refused; palbociclib and capivasertib extensions withdrawn

items.keyData: n=303 · chronic irAEs 48% · ongoing at last follow-up 34% · hypothyroidism 31%
items.summary: A multicentre retrospective cohort of 303 patients with resected stage III–IV melanoma found chronic irAEs in 48%, most persisting at a median 67 months of follow-up. Hypothyroidism was the commonest, and all adrenal insufficiency/hypophysitis cases were permanent — relevant when counselling on adjuvant therapy.
items.title: Chronic immune-related adverse events affect nearly half of patients after adjuvant anti–PD-1 for melanoma

items.keyData: START-001 TMB-H cohort (n=44) · ORR 20.5% · DCR 79.5%
items.summary: The FDA granted Marengo's bispecific dual T-cell agonist invikafusp alfa (STAR0602) a second fast track designation, covering TMB-H solid tumours progressing after prior therapy including checkpoint inhibitors. Updated phase 2 START-001 data are due as an ESMO 2026 oral on 23 October.
items.title: Fast track for invikafusp alfa expanded to tissue-agnostic TMB-high solid tumours

items.keyData: Hypothyroidism 5.8% (IMPT) vs ~19% (IMRT) · adj. OR 2.94 · mean thyroid dose 17 vs 27 Gy
items.summary: A retrospective ASTRO 2026 poster comparing IMPT with photon IMRT for regional nodal breast RT found clinical hypothyroidism in 5.8% vs about 19%, tracking a lower mean thyroid dose. The presenter cautioned it is not practice-changing; the key message is to contour the thyroid as an organ at risk in every plan.
items.title: Proton therapy linked to less hypothyroidism after supraclavicular breast irradiation

items.keyData: 10 conditional recommendations · NGS testing (moderate certainty) · early allo-HCT referral
items.summary: The ASH guideline in Blood Advances favours NGS-based molecular testing over limited driver-mutation testing, advises against starting JAK inhibitors in asymptomatic higher-risk MF, and suggests momelotinib or pacritinib when anaemia dominates. It also recommends early transplant referral for responding higher-risk patients; all recommendations are conditional, mostly on low or very low certainty evidence.
items.title: ASH publishes first myelofibrosis management guideline with 10 recommendations

items.keyData: FYB206 · Dahlia PK equivalence met · BsUFA decision ~Q3 2027
items.summary: India's Zydus Lifesciences and Formycon said the FDA accepted for review the first publicly announced Keytruda biosimilar application; a dossier is also with Health Canada. FYB206 was developed without a comparative phase 3 efficacy trial, relying on analytics and the Dahlia PK-equivalence study in resected melanoma; a decision could come around Q3 2027.
items.title: FDA accepts Zydus–Formycon BLA for pembrolizumab biosimilar FYB206

items.keyData: PEGASUS · n=135 · 2-yr RFS 88% (target ≥92%) · 3-yr DFS ctDNA+ 58.4% vs ctDNA− 82.8%, HR 2.71
items.summary: In this single-arm phase 2 trial of serial ctDNA-guided escalation/de-escalation in MSS colon cancer, 2-year RFS in patients ctDNA-negative after surgery was 88%, below the prespecified 92% target. The approach cut neurotoxicity versus a historical cohort, but the authors say randomised validation is needed.
items.title: PEGASUS: ctDNA-guided adjuvant chemotherapy misses primary endpoint in high-risk stage II/III colon cancer

items.keyData: RASolute 302 · mOS 13.2 vs 6.7 mo · HR 0.40 · mPFS 7.2 vs 3.6 mo · HR 0.49
items.summary: The EMA's CHMP recommended EU authorisation of the oral RAS(ON) inhibitor daraxonrasib as monotherapy for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma after at least one prior systemic therapy, based on RASolute 302 versus chemotherapy. A European Commission decision follows; the drug has been FDA-approved since August.
items.title: CHMP backs daraxonrasib (Rasonque) for previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer

items.keyData: CLOVER-WaM BTKi subset · ORR 87.5% · MRR 79.2% · DOR >16 mo
items.summary: A CLOVER-WaM subgroup analysis presented at the International Workshop on Waldenström Macroglobulinemia reported high response rates with the phospholipid-ether radioconjugate given right after BTK inhibitor failure in patients with at least two prior lines. The company plans an accelerated-approval NDA in the first half of 2027.
items.title: Iopofosine I-131 shows high response rates in BTK inhibitor–refractory Waldenström macroglobulinaemia

items.summary: The FDA's April–June 2026 list of potential serious-risk signals (posted 30 September) includes colitis with palbociclib, ribociclib and abemaciclib, myocarditis with BRAF and MEK inhibitors, enterocolitis with ide-cel and liso-cel, and Lutathera/Pluvicto mix-up errors. FDA is evaluating need for action; no labels have changed yet.
items.title: FDA FAERS quarterly signals flag colitis with CDK4/6 inhibitors and myocarditis with BRAF/MEK inhibitors

items.keyData: ALLELE (n=75) · ORR 50.7% · CR 28.0% · mDOR 23.0 mo · mOS 18.4 mo
items.summary: FDA accepted the Class 2 BLA resubmission for the allogeneic EBV-specific T-cell therapy tabelecleucel as monotherapy for patients aged 2 and older with EBV+ PTLD after at least one prior therapy; the resubmission adds patients and longer follow-up from ALLELE.
items.title: Tabelecleucel in relapsed/refractory EBV+ post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease

items.keyData: RASolute 302 ORR · all 33% · G12V 50% · G12D 24% · G12R 7%
items.summary: Released FDA review documents for RASolute 302 break down objective response by KRAS variant: responses were highest with G12V and lower with G12D, the most common subtype, while the small G12R group responded poorly. Overall survival benefit in the full population was the basis of approval.
items.title: FDA review documents show lower daraxonrasib response rates in KRAS G12D and G12R pancreatic cancer

items.keyData: 3,060 survivors · transition-eligible 398 → projected 1,071 by 2030 (+169%) · ~58% live >50 km from centre
items.summary: An analysis from AIIMS Delhi, Rajiv Gandhi Cancer Institute and KGMU Lucknow of survivors who finished therapy in 2016–2025 estimates the number reaching adulthood and needing transition to adult survivorship care will rise sharply, with most at moderate-to-high late-effect risk and many living far from their treating centre.
items.title: North Indian multicentre study projects near-tripling of childhood cancer survivors needing adult transition by 2030

items.keyData: LUNAR (n=92) · mPFS 17.6 vs 7.4 mo · 62% lower risk of progression/ADT/death · mTime to ADT 24.3 vs 14.1 mo · 2-yr no detectable disease 33% vs 12%
items.summary: Updated results of the randomised phase 2 LUNAR trial, now in European Urology, show two cycles of 177Lu-PNT2002 before SBRT continue to delay progression and need for further hormone therapy versus SBRT alone in oligorecurrent hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, at a median follow-up of 31.9 months.
items.title: LUNAR update: Lu-177 PSMA before SBRT keeps oligorecurrent prostate cancer controlled longer

items.keyData: QUILT-3.032 Cohort A (CIS, n=77) · CR 62% · 58% of CRs lasting ≥12 mo, 40% ≥24 mo
items.summary: The IL-15 superagonist (Anktiva) with BCG, previously approved for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC with carcinoma in situ, is now also indicated for high-grade papillary-only disease. FDA based the expansion on extrapolation from the CIS cohort of QUILT-3.032.
items.title: FDA extends nogapendekin alfa inbakicept plus BCG to papillary-only BCG-unresponsive NMIBC

items.summary: In a randomised open-label phase 3 trial at five Chinese centres (n=190), the DPP-4 inhibitor sitagliptin added to standard prophylaxis reduced grade 2–4 and grade 3–4 acute GVHD by day 100 after myeloablative alternative-donor HCT, without a significant difference in 2-year overall or relapse-free survival. Published in JCO.
items.title: Adding sitagliptin to GVHD prophylaxis halves acute GVHD after haploidentical or unrelated-donor transplant

items.keyData: mPDAC 2L+ 900 mg (n=22): ORR 41% · DCR 86% · 6-mo PFS 67% · NSCLC 2L+ 600 mg (n=23): ORR 43% · 6-mo PFS 72%
items.summary: Verastem reported updated phase 1/2 TARGET-D 101 data for VS-7375 in KRAS G12D-mutant cancers, with mostly low-grade GI toxicity and 2% discontinuation at 900 mg. FDA has agreed the design of a three-arm first-line metastatic PDAC phase 3 (TARGET-D 301), due to open by end of 2026.
items.title: Oral KRAS G12D ON/OFF inhibitor VS-7375 shows responses in pretreated pancreatic and lung cancer; phase 3 planned

items.keyData: Neoadjuvant: 30 Gy/1.8–2 Gy, 30–39 Gy/1.5 Gy BID or 40.8 Gy/1.2 Gy BID · palliative 8 Gy×1 or 4 Gy×5 · cumulative EQD2(α/β 3) <90 Gy often deliverable
items.summary: ESTRO's lower-GI sub-committee published systematic-review-based recommendations for rectal cancer reirradiation, advising MDT discussion for all patients, hyperfractionated or conventional schedules with fluoropyrimidines in the neoadjuvant or definitive setting, and short palliative courses for poor-prognosis patients. The authors note most evidence is low quality.
items.title: ESTRO guideline on reirradiation for recurrent rectal cancer, endorsed by ASTRO

items.keyData: mUM: mOS 20.8 mo (Dec 2023 cut) / 18.4 mo (Feb 2026) · mPFS 5.3 mo · related Gr ≥3 TEAEs 6.8%
items.summary: The phase 1 DIONE-01 study (n=44) found no dose-limiting toxicities and few drug-related grade ≥3 events with the oral allosteric PI3Kδ inhibitor; in the uveal melanoma expansion, median OS was about 18–21 months, though responses were rare and the data are uncontrolled. A randomised phase 2 (OCULE-01) is ongoing.
items.title: First-in-human trial of PI3Kδ inhibitor roginolisib reports long survival in pretreated metastatic uveal melanoma

items.keyData: AHEAD-MERIT (Ph 2/3) · PFS not significant · OS readout pending
items.summary: In first-line PD-L1 CPS ≥1, HPV16-positive recurrent/metastatic HNSCC, adding BNT113 to pembrolizumab did not significantly improve progression-free survival at this analysis. The IDMC recommended continuing the trial to the second dual primary endpoint, overall survival; no efficacy numbers were released.
items.title: AHEAD-MERIT: mRNA vaccine BNT113 plus pembrolizumab misses PFS endpoint in HPV16+ head and neck cancer

items.keyData: LBA1 INTerpath-001 · LBA11 TroFuse-005 · LBA12 KEYNOTE-C93 · 1239O NRG-GY020
items.summary: Merck listed three Presidential Symposium phase 3 presentations for ESMO (Madrid, 23–27 Oct): adjuvant mRNA neoantigen therapy intismeran plus pembrolizumab in melanoma (LBA1), sacituzumab tirumotecan in endometrial cancer (LBA11) and first-line pembrolizumab monotherapy in dMMR endometrial cancer (LBA12). NRG-GY020, testing pembrolizumab added to radiotherapy in endometrial cancer, is also being presented (1239O).
items.title: ESMO 2026 Presidential late-breakers: INTerpath-001, TroFuse-005 and KEYNOTE-C93; NRG-GY020 RT ± pembrolizumab also on programme

items.keyData: QoL improved 75.8% vs 6.3% · no exercise-related AEs · ~83% adherence ≥6 wk
items.summary: In a Brazilian randomised phase 2 trial (70 patients), a 12-week telehealth exercise programme led by a physiologist improved quality of life and cancer-related fatigue versus usual care, with roughly half the QoL gain explained by less fatigue. To be presented at the 2026 ASCO Quality Care Symposium.
items.title: Remote supervised exercise reduces fatigue and improves quality of life during immunotherapy

items.keyData: CARES-310 · mOS 23.8 vs 15.2 mo · HR 0.64 · mPFS 5.6 vs 3.7 mo
items.summary: Elevar and Hengrui refiled the NDA and BLA on 9 October after manufacturing-site inspections concluded; the July 2026 complete response letter (the third) cited manufacturing deficiencies, not efficacy or safety. The filing rests on the CARES-310 phase 3 trial versus sorafenib; no new PDUFA date has been announced.
items.title: Rivoceranib plus camrelizumab resubmitted to FDA for first-line unresectable HCC

items.keyData: Ph 1 (n=5) · 1 PR (~80% shrinkage) · no grade ≥3 AEs
items.summary: T-MAXIMUM's allogeneic B7-H3-directed CAR T product MT027 can proceed to a phase 2 study in brain metastases from lung or breast cancer. Supporting phase 1 data are very small: among 5 pretreated patients with lung cancer brain metastases there was 1 partial response and no grade ≥3 drug-related toxicity.
items.title: FDA clears phase 2 trial of intrathecal B7-H3 CAR T-cell therapy MT027 for brain metastases

items.keyData: RELIGHT · OS CPS≥5 16.8 vs 10.4 mo, HR 0.53 · OS ITT 15.8 vs 11.2 mo, HR 0.66 · ORR 53.4% vs 32.8%
items.summary: This Chinese phase 3 trial (n=731) found that adding retlirafusp alfa to CAPOX prolonged overall survival in both the PD-L1 CPS ≥5 and intention-to-treat populations versus placebo plus CAPOX, published in JCO. The main limitation is the chemotherapy-alone comparator rather than PD-1 inhibitor plus chemotherapy.
items.title: RELIGHT: PD-L1/TGF-β trap retlirafusp alfa plus CAPOX improves survival in first-line HER2− gastric/GEJ cancer

items.keyData: C-800-01 (n=123, no liver mets) · ORR 21% · mOS 21.2 mo (exploratory)
items.summary: Armenia's health ministry authorised the Fc-enhanced CTLA-4 antibody botensilimab with PD-1 antibody balstilimab for previously treated MSS mCRC without active liver metastases, on a one-year renewable basis. Evidence is from single-arm studies; the OS-powered phase 3 BATTMAN trial was terminated after funding was withdrawn.
items.title: Armenia grants world-first conditional authorisation to botensilimab plus balstilimab in MSS colorectal cancer

items.keyData: RACC · intraop complications 5.7% vs 10.0% · RR 0.57 · stay 3 vs 5 days · RFS pending
items.summary: A prespecified secondary analysis of the 900-patient RACC randomised trial (stage IB1–IIA1) found fewer intraoperative complications, less blood loss and shorter stays with robot-assisted surgery, with similar 30-day postoperative complications. The oncological primary endpoint, recurrence-free survival, is still in follow-up — the key question after LACC.
items.title: RACC: robot-assisted radical hysterectomy has fewer intraoperative complications than open surgery in early cervical cancer

items.keyData: Phase 2 NCT07111546 · ~140 enrolled · 2nd fast track (first: extrapulmonary NEC)
items.summary: The FDA granted fast track designation to opamtistomig (LBL-024) for first-line advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer. A phase 2 study is testing it with gemcitabine-cisplatin or with bevacizumab, with BTC data expected at ESMO 2026.
items.title: Fast track for PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific opamtistomig in first-line biliary tract cancer

items.keyData: ACTION-1 (NCT05477576) · PFS primary endpoint met (no HR disclosed) · comparator: high-dose SSA, everolimus or sunitinib
items.summary: At a planned interim analysis, the phase 3 ACTION-1 trial met its primary endpoint of BICR-assessed PFS for RYZ101 versus investigator's-choice standard of care in SSTR-positive GEP-NETs progressing after Lu-177-based PRRT. Numbers were not released; full data will go to a future meeting and the company plans to discuss a filing with the FDA.
items.title: ACTION-1: alpha-emitter RYZ101 (225Ac-DOTATATE) improves PFS in GEP-NETs after Lu-177 therapy

items.summary: An interim analysis of the phase 2 ENV-105 trial in mCRPC progressing on an AR pathway inhibitor showed markedly longer PFS when carotuximab was added to apalutamide versus apalutamide alone. Data are early and from a small open-label study.
items.title: Endoglin antibody carotuximab plus apalutamide prolongs PFS in mCRPC (phase 2 interim)

items.keyData: Localised Ewing: interval-compressed VDC/IE ×14 cycles · 5-yr survival 81% localised vs 41% metastatic
items.summary: NCCN released its first guideline for paediatric bone sarcoma covering Ewing sarcoma and other undifferentiated round cell sarcomas. Interval-compressed VDC alternating with IE is the recommended first-line systemic therapy for localised and metastatic Ewing sarcoma, with trial enrolment encouraged.
items.title: NCCN publishes first paediatric bone sarcoma guideline, focused on Ewing sarcoma

items.summary: The phase 3 NRG-GI003 trial (115 eligible patients) stopped for futility at interim analysis: protons did not extend overall or progression-free survival versus photons in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. Grade ≥3 toxicity was numerically lower with protons but not statistically significant.
items.title: NRG-GI003: proton therapy does not improve survival over photon RT in advanced HCC

items.keyData: NRG-CC009 (n=151) · mOS 17.4 vs 8.6 mo · adj. HR death 0.60 (P=.016) · NCF HR 0.83 (P=.39)
items.summary: In 151 patients with SCLC brain metastases randomised to stereotactic radiosurgery or hippocampal-avoidant whole-brain RT plus memantine, the primary endpoint of time to neurocognitive failure did not differ, but overall survival was longer with SRS. Presented at the ASTRO 2026 plenary, it supports SRS as a reasonable option in SCLC.
items.title: NRG-CC009: SRS instead of HA-WBRT for SCLC brain metastases — no cognitive difference, longer survival

items.keyData: TRIlogy-1 · n=56 · MRD-neg 95% (10⁻⁵), 93.3% (10⁻⁶) among tested · median 3 prior lines
items.summary: Phase 1 TRIlogy-1 data presented at IMS 2026 showed very high rates of MRD negativity with ramantamig (JNJ-5322) monotherapy in heavily pretreated, largely anti-CD38-refractory relapsed/refractory myeloma.
items.title: Trispecific ramantamig achieves high MRD negativity in triple-class-exposed myeloma

items.keyData: ROAM/EORTC-1308 · n=157 · 5-y DFS 79.9% vs 64.3% · HR 0.51 · recurrence 14% vs 30% · median FU 64 mo
items.summary: In the first randomised trial of its kind, 60 Gy IMRT after complete resection of WHO grade 2 meningioma halved the risk of recurrence or death versus active MRI surveillance, with more adverse events but no clear cognitive or QoL penalty; no overall survival difference so far. Published in The Lancet.
items.title: ROAM/EORTC-1308: adjuvant radiotherapy cuts recurrence after gross total resection of atypical meningioma

items.keyData: Belgium, Denmark, France, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Sweden, Switzerland · IV Keytruda unaffected
items.summary: A court in the Netherlands found that Merck's subcutaneous Keytruda infringes a Halozyme hyaluronidase (MDASE) patent and ordered Merck to stop making and selling it in eight countries; intravenous pembrolizumab is unaffected, and a separate German injunction is under appeal.
items.title: Dutch court blocks subcutaneous pembrolizumab in eight European countries over Halozyme patent

items.keyData: OST31-164-01 · n=41 · 3-y OS 72.7% vs 45.8% historical · 12-mo EFS 33% vs 20%
items.summary: Final phase 2b data for daznelimgene lisbac showed higher 3-year overall survival than a pooled historical control in adolescents and young adults after complete resection of pulmonary metastases; the comparison is non-randomised. An accelerated-approval BLA is planned for Q4 2026.
items.title: Listeria-based HER2 immunotherapy OST-HER2 reports 3-year OS in resected lung-metastatic osteosarcoma

items.keyData: PrTK03 parent trial · DFS HR 0.70 · negative biopsy at 22-26 mo 80% vs 63% · paired residual-tumour analysis n=108
items.summary: An ASTRO 2026 late-breaker used machine-learning digital pathology on biopsies from the phase 3 PrTK03 trial and found greater immune infiltration after intraprostatic aglatimagene plus EBRT than after placebo plus EBRT, offering a possible mechanism for the trial's DFS benefit; P values are nominal.
items.title: Aglatimagene with EBRT increases intratumoral lymphocytes in localized prostate cancer (PrTK03 translational analysis)

items.keyData: n=3,259 · 6-mo abstinence 8.8% (incentives) vs 5.1% (pharmacotherapy) vs 4.3% (usual care) · +4.6 pts vs usual care, P<.001
items.summary: A four-arm pragmatic RCT in JAMA found that adding cash incentives for biochemically confirmed abstinence raised 6-month quit rates over usual care and over free pharmacotherapy alone, while a mobile health tool added nothing further.
items.title: Financial incentives double quit rates in underserved patients referred for lung cancer screening

items.keyData: 25,328 exams (4,218 ABUS vs 21,110 HHUS) · CDR similar · recall lower with ABUS
items.source: Journal of the American College of Radiology
items.summary: Across 25,328 screening ultrasound exams in three US BCSC registries, automated breast ultrasound had a similar cancer detection rate to handheld ultrasound with lower recall and false-positive rates.
items.title: Automated breast ultrasound matches handheld ultrasound for supplemental screening with fewer recalls

items.summary: The cfDNA screening test, which also predicts the cancer signal origin, received Breakthrough Device status after FDA review of data across 12 cancer types; no performance figures were disclosed and the designation is not a clearance.
items.title: Natera's blood-based multi-cancer early detection assay gets FDA Breakthrough Device designation

items.summary: The liquid biopsy received IVDR CE marking to detect ESR1 mutations that select patients for camizestrant plus a CDK4/6 inhibitor in ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer, following the EU approval of camizestrant in July 2026.
items.title: Guardant360 CDx certified in EU as companion diagnostic for camizestrant

items.keyData: 110 drugs (35 patented) · margin cap 30% of MRP
items.summary: According to government sources, trade margins on 110 non-scheduled anti-cancer medicines, including 35 patented drugs, will be limited to 30% of MRP, covering branded, generic and imported products; implementation is expected later in October.
items.title: India to cap trade margins on 110 anti-cancer drugs at 30% of MRP

items.keyData: TROPION-Breast02 · mPFS 10.8 vs 5.6 mo · HR 0.57 · mOS 23.7 vs 18.7 mo · HR 0.79 · ORR 63% vs 29%
items.summary: China's NMPA approved Dato-DXd for unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer in patients who are not candidates for PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors, based on TROPION-Breast02, which showed PFS and OS gains over chemotherapy.
items.title: China approves datopotamab deruxtecan for metastatic TNBC unsuitable for PD-(L)1 therapy

items.keyData: DESTINY-Breast05 · IDFS HR 0.47 · 3-yr IDFS 92.4% vs 83.7% (vs T-DM1)
items.summary: NMPA approved trastuzumab deruxtecan as adjuvant therapy after neoadjuvant taxane-trastuzumab when invasive disease remains, based on DESTINY-Breast05 versus T-DM1.
items.title: China approves adjuvant T-DXd for HER2+ early breast cancer with residual disease

items.keyData: Phase 1, n=33 · relapses 0/16 vs 3/16 (median 30 mo) · immune response 73% · no grade ≥3 vaccine AEs
items.summary: In a small randomised phase 1 study after surgery and adjuvant therapy, immediate TG4050 vaccination produced neoantigen-specific immune responses with no relapses versus 3 relapses in the observation arm; the trial was not powered for efficacy.
items.title: Individualised neoantigen vaccine TG4050 shows durable T-cell responses in resected HPV-negative HNSCC

items.keyData: FURVENT · 240 mg mPFS 11.0 vs 9.5 mo · HR 0.75 (p=0.065) · ORR 60% vs 33%
items.summary: Neither firmonertinib dose significantly improved BICR-assessed PFS over platinum-pemetrexed, although the 240 mg arm had a higher response rate and fewer grade ≥3 treatment-related AEs; the sponsor is reviewing next steps.
items.title: FURVENT: firmonertinib misses PFS endpoint in first-line EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC

items.keyData: EPCORE DLBCL-2 · PFS HR 0.49 (IPI 3–5 and IPI 2–5) · p<0.0001
items.summary: Topline phase 3 results show adding the CD20xCD3 bispecific to R-CHOP roughly halved the risk of progression or death in IPI 3–5 and IPI 2–5 patients; OS and safety details are awaited.
items.title: EPCORE DLBCL-2: epcoritamab plus R-CHOP improves PFS in newly diagnosed high-risk DLBCL

items.keyData: n=242 · 1-yr cavity control 87% vs 81% (p=0.046) · mOS 29 vs 20 mo · HR 0.69 (p=0.035) · necrosis 14% vs 10%
items.summary: In a phase 3 trial of 242 patients with a resected brain metastasis over 2 cm, 3–5 fraction SRS improved surgical-bed control and overall survival versus single-fraction SRS without more toxicity; the investigators propose fSRS as standard of care for larger cavities.
items.title: Alliance A071801: fractionated SRS beats single-fraction SRS after resection of brain metastases

items.keyData: Neoadjuvant THP · HER2DX + ER status → pCR prediction
items.summary: ER status and the HER2DX genomic score predicted complete response to de-escalated neoadjuvant paclitaxel-trastuzumab-pertuzumab in HER2-positive early breast cancer.
items.title: HER2DX score and hormone receptor status predict pCR with neoadjuvant THP

items.keyData: EXCALIBER-RRMM phase 3 · IberDd vs DVd · PFS risk ↓51%
items.summary: Iberdomide plus daratumumab and dexamethasone improved progression-free survival versus daratumumab, bortezomib and dexamethasone in the phase 3 trial.
items.title: EXCALIBER-RRMM: iberdomide-dara-dex beats DVd in relapsed myeloma

items.summary: A pan-cancer analysis found that restricting germline testing by age at diagnosis overlooks most pathogenic inherited variants, supporting broader testing for treatment and family-risk decisions.
items.title: Age-based germline testing criteria miss most inherited cancer variants

items.keyData: ATOMIC (phase 3) · adjuvant atezolizumab + mFOLFOX6 vs mFOLFOX6
items.summary: Atezolizumab added to adjuvant FOLFOX for resected stage III deficient mismatch repair colon cancer, based on the phase 3 ATOMIC trial.
items.title: FDA approves adjuvant atezolizumab plus chemotherapy for dMMR colon cancer

items.summary: Vir Biotechnology's masked, PSMA-directed T-cell engager VIR-5500 received FDA fast track designation for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
items.title: Fast track for PSMA-targeted T-cell engager VIR-5500 in mCRPC

items.keyData: SURVIVE · OS primary endpoint not met · benefit in ≤65 y subgroup
items.summary: The survivin-targeted vaccine did not meet its primary overall survival endpoint because the standard-of-care arm lived longer than expected; benefit was seen in patients aged 65 or younger.
items.title: SURVIVE: SurVaxM misses OS endpoint in newly diagnosed glioblastoma

items.keyData: HER2CLIMB-05 · mPFS 24.9 vs 16.3 mo
items.summary: Tucatinib added to maintenance trastuzumab and pertuzumab after first-line induction, based on the HER2CLIMB-05 trial.
items.title: FDA approves tucatinib maintenance with trastuzumab–pertuzumab in HER2+ metastatic breast cancer

items.summary: The FDA granted breakthrough therapy designation to Temab-A in colorectal cancer and in c-Met–expressing non-small cell lung cancer.
items.title: c-Met ADC telisotuzumab adizutecan (Temab-A) gets two breakthrough designations

items.keyData: NRG-BR002 (n=125) · mPFS 23 mo SOC vs 19.5 mo with ablation · OS no difference
items.summary: Adding SBRT or surgery to all metastatic sites on top of first-line systemic therapy did not improve progression-free or overall survival in oligometastatic breast cancer (≤4 metastases), so the phase 3 part will not proceed. Full results published in JCO.
items.title: NRG-BR002: SBRT to oligometastases fails to extend PFS in breast cancer

items.keyData: BRUIN CLL-313 (n=282) · PFS HR 0.20 vs BR · mPFS NE vs 33.5 mo
items.summary: The non-covalent BTK inhibitor is now approved first line for chronic lymphocytic leukaemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma without known 17p deletion, after beating bendamustine-rituximab.
items.title: FDA approves pirtobrutinib for previously untreated CLL/SLL

items.keyData: iMMagine-1 · ORR 97% · sCR/CR 68%
items.summary: BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy.
items.title: Anito-cel in relapsed/refractory myeloma after ≥3 lines

items.keyData: PEAK · mPFS 16.5 vs 9.2 mo · HR 0.50
items.summary: Type 1 plus type 2 KIT inhibition to cover more resistance mutations.
items.title: Bezuclastinib + sunitinib in GIST after imatinib

items.keyData: lidERA · IDFS HR 0.70 vs standard endocrine therapy
items.summary: Would be the first oral SERD in the curative setting.
items.title: Giredestrant as adjuvant therapy in ER+/HER2− early breast cancer

items.keyData: evERA · mPFS 8.77 vs 5.49 mo · HR 0.56 (ESR1m HR 0.38)
items.summary: After progression on prior endocrine-based therapy.
items.title: Giredestrant + everolimus in ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer

items.keyData: HARMONi · mPFS 6.8 vs 4.4 mo · HR 0.52
items.summary: PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody with platinum doublet after osimertinib-type progression.
items.title: Ivonescimab + chemo in EGFR-mutant NSCLC after 3rd-gen TKI

items.keyData: ALKOVE-1 · ORR 31% · intracranial 32% · G1202R ORR 68%
items.summary: Next-generation ALK TKI under priority review, with activity against G1202R.
items.title: Neladalkib in pretreated ALK+ NSCLC

items.keyData: MANEUVER · ORR 54.0% vs 3.2% at wk 25
items.summary: Oral CSF-1R inhibitor with breakthrough designation; also improved pain, stiffness and function.
items.title: Pimicotinib in tenosynovial giant cell tumour

items.keyData: TALAPRO-3 · rPFS HR 0.48 · 3-y rPFS 77% vs 56%
items.summary: Priority review for the PARP inhibitor combination in castration-sensitive disease.
items.title: Talazoparib + enzalutamide in HRR-mutated mCSPC

items.keyData: PROSPECT (n=48) · ORR 66.7% · CR/CRu 43.8% · mPFS 6.0 mo
items.summary: Second-generation BTK inhibitor, already approved in Japan.
items.title: Tirabrutinib in relapsed/refractory primary CNS lymphoma

items.keyData: ESMO 2026 · Madrid · Oct 23–27
items.summary: Expected highlights include postMONARCH and FINER overall survival in HR+ breast cancer, TALAPRO-3 in mCSPC, SARON consolidation radiotherapy in oligometastatic NSCLC, LITESPARK-011 final results and HERIZON-GEA-01 in gastroesophageal cancer.
items.title: ESMO Congress 2026, Madrid, 23–27 October: readouts to watch

items.keyData: VOLGA (n=695) · EFS and OS improved vs radical cystectomy
items.summary: Priority review granted based on VOLGA, which improved event-free and overall survival versus cystectomy alone. Decision expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
items.title: Perioperative durvalumab + enfortumab vedotin in cisplatin-ineligible MIBC

items.keyData: OASIS-4 (n=474) · −3.4 episodes/day vs placebo at wk 12
items.summary: The dual NK-1/NK-3 antagonist is under priority review for moderate to severe hot flushes in patients on endocrine therapy for HR+ breast cancer.
items.title: Elinzanetant gets priority review for vasomotor symptoms on endocrine therapy

items.keyData: IDeate-Lung01 · ORR 48.2% · mDOR 5.3 mo · ILD 12.4%
items.summary: Daiichi Sankyo and Merck withdrew the ifinatamab deruxtecan BLA after the FDA said phase 2 IDeate-Lung01 data did not meet accelerated approval requirements. Phase 3 IDeate-Lung02 is nearly fully enrolled.
items.title: I-DXd application in extensive-stage SCLC withdrawn

items.keyData: LITESPARK-011 · mPFS 14.6 vs 10.6 mo · HR 0.74 · ORR 53% vs 40% · OS HR 0.85 (NS)
items.summary: The HIF-2α inhibitor combination beat cabozantinib on PFS and response; final overall survival was not statistically significant.
items.title: FDA approves belzutifan plus lenvatinib for ccRCC after PD-1/PD-L1 therapy

items.keyData: Benefit-risk 7–2 · PATHFINDER 2 sensitivity 35.0%, specificity 99.85%
items.summary: Advisory panel supported the blood test as a prescription screen for adults 50 and older. The vote does not bind the FDA's final decision.
items.title: FDA panel votes in favour of Galleri multi-cancer early detection test

items.summary: Fast track in osteosarcoma and orphan drug designation in soft tissue sarcoma; first-in-human trial expected later in 2026.
items.title: LRRC15-directed ADC SOT106 gets new designations in sarcoma
